newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom near high at bourse end.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom near high at bourse end.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG traded at 33.90 marks ($22.52), just off their day-high, by the end of bourse trade on their market debut on Monday.

The shares had earlier opened at 33.20 marks, significantly higher than their 28.50 issue price. Dealers said the main impact on the stock had been buying by institutions seeking to top up small allocations in the heavily-oversubscribed issue.
The stock had earlier touched a high of 34.10 marks. Overall, a massive 37.7 million Telekom shares changed hands, dwarfing volumes in other blue-chip stocks in Frankfurt.

"There is still a good chance that it can improve on this (current) level. There are a couple of institutions out there that didn't get much of an allocation but still haven't gone into the market yet," said one trader.
Telekom shares traded at 33.70 over the IBIS all-day electronic trading system. Telekom shares are due to be traded in New York later on Monday and Tokyo on Tuesday.
